## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- **No Inline CSS:** Explicitly forbidden to use `style="..."` attributes or `<style>` blocks in `index.html`. All styling lives in `style.css`.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic (header, nav, main, section, article, footer), and agnostic of visual styling. Changing the site's look must require editing only `style.css`.

**1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens**
Seed `:root` with the provided Cyber Sigilism token block, then **extend** it with the full mandatory token set:
- **Colors (dark, canonical):** `--primary: #d6d8e4`, `--secondary: #282832`, `--bg-primary: #0e0e12`, `--bg-secondary: #17171d`, `--text-primary: #ececf2`, `--text-secondary: #aaaab8`, `--accent: #b068ff`, `--chrome: #7d8495`. Keep the original `--color-*` names as aliases mapped to these. Add `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default` (chrome `#7d8495`), `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
- **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token must pair with a dark text token and every dark background token with a light text token — enforced in **both** themes, not just the default.
- **Light Mode Background:** The light theme must read as "bone/graphite paper" (e.g., `--bg-primary: #e8e8ee`, `--bg-secondary: #f2f2f6`, surfaces `#fefefe`, ink `#101016`, muted `#55555f`, accent darkened to ~`#7c3fd6` for text/icons). Never use `#ffffff`; use `#fefefe` where a near-white is needed.
- **Radius & Shadows:** Keep `--radius-sm: 0`, `--radius-md: 2px`, `--radius-lg: 6px`, `--radius-pill: 999px`, `--shadow-metal`, `--shadow-sigil`; add `--shadow-sm` and `--shadow-md`.
- **Spacing & Transitions:** Keep the `--space-*` scale; add `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast` (~.18s), `--transition-normal` (~.3s), `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)`.
- **Elevation/Stacking:** Define `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast` and use them for the nav, any overlay, and any toast/feedback layer.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support (Dark-Canonical Theme)**
- **Implementation:** Dark is the canonical theme — dark tokens live in `:root`; light overrides live under `[data-theme="light"]` (and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)` when no stored preference exists). Theme switching must require zero HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** Store the user's choice in `localStorage`; fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Apply the stored theme as early as possible in `script.js` to minimize flash.
- **Toggle Control:** A visible toggle in the nav using Google Material Symbols (`dark_mode`/`light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and dynamic `aria-label`.
- **Validation Requirement:** The source specification states the theme must be **validated in both light and dark before publishing** — verify WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text/UI borders) in both modes before finalizing.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless there is an explicitly justified exception (permitted exceptions: `stretch` for equal-height pricing/feature cards and stacked form field groups — document each in a CSS comment).
- **Mobile-Friendly First:** All layouts must be responsive out of the box — nav wraps, multi-column grids stack, hero content stacks vertically below ~620px. **No horizontal scrolling at any viewport width.**
- **Grid Exception:** CSS Grid is permitted only for multi-column card/pricing/feature layouts (`repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))` per the provided primitives); all other containers use Flexbox.

**1.5 Framework Default & Naming Convention**

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component Requirements**
Style all states via CSS classes, building on the provided `.btn` primitive (ensure `min-height: 44px` for touch targets):
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`.
- **Hover:** Chrome/accent shift with `--shadow-sigil` glow and `translateY(-2px)`; `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** Distinct `:focus-visible` ring using `outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px` for keyboard navigation.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` click feedback.
- **Loading:** Disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, and renders a CSS spinner (a rotating conic-gradient sigil ring) without distorting button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`, no transform.
- **Success/Error:** Temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.
- **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (bone/chrome fill, sigil glow), `.btn--ghost` (1px chrome outline), `.btn--danger` (visually distinct in both themes) if a destructive action exists.

**2.2 Card Component Requirements**
Applies to feature, testimonial, and pricing cards:
- **Default:** Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, 1px `--border-default` chrome edge, `--shadow-metal` elevation.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus a shadow shift toward `--shadow-sigil`.
- **Focus-within:** Card border highlights in `--accent` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** Chrome shimmer animation defined in CSS, preserving layout dimensions.
- **Empty State:** Structured fallback with a Google Material Symbol icon and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
Used for the Final CTA email capture (and any footer signup):
- **States:** Empty, Focused (accent outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border + check icon), Invalid (error border, `--text-error` message, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- **Structure:** Flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the `.input` field, and a dedicated error/success feedback element with `aria-live="polite"`.
- **Never color-only:** Invalid and valid states must pair color with an icon and text message.

**2.4 Accordion (FAQ) & Modal Requirements**
- **FAQ Accordion:** Each item is a `<button aria-expanded="true|false">` header (with a rotating Material Symbols chevron) plus a panel; open/close animated via CSS transitions (`max-height`/`opacity`); fully keyboard operable; panels not focusable when closed.
- **If any modal/popup is used:** States — Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing — all animated via CSS transitions. Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay with `backdrop-filter: blur`, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` and overlay click, layered at `--z-modal`.
